entry.title: [Photograph of Cattle Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of a cattle ranch near Hahndorf, Australia. Brown and white cattle sit in a green, hilly field bordered by wire fencing. A small, square house with a grey, hipped roof sit at the bottom of the hills, surrounded by several bushes and trees. White roads run along the hills, leading to the house. Clusters and lines of trees sit in the background of the photograph.

entry.title: [Cattle Ranch in Fort Bend]
entry.content: Postcard, Cattle Ranch-Ft. Bend Co. Cattle in a pasture. One white-faced cow with horns (in center of photo) is facing camera.

entry.title: [Cattle on a Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of cattle on a ranch in Hereford, Texas, taken for a Steelways Magazine article on Hereford.

entry.title: [Photograph of Cattle at Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of a group of cattle standing in a field with some trees. A handwritten note on the back of the photo says "This picture was taken at Yeagers Ranch where we had our first picnic - back in Feb. 1944. We took our car through this open spot you see here. The cows followed. We had our picnic on top of the hill in the background."

entry.title: [Photograph of Scene on Bogel's Cattle Ranch, Presidio Co., Texas]
entry.content: Photograph of a view of the Bogel's ranch and the surrounding landscape. In the foreground, there is a low fence and a large group of cattle on either side. Inside the fence there are several wooden corrals. In the background, there is brush and what appears to be another large group of cows. On the left of the photograph, there is a long building (only partially visible) which may be a barn, another structure, and a windmill. In the background of the photograph, there are long, low mountains. A handwritten note at the bottom of the photograph says "Scene on Bogel's Cattle Ranch, Presidio Co. Texas." and "Duncan Photo."

entry.title: [Photograph of Scene on Bogel's Cattle Ranch, Presidio Co., Texas]
entry.content: Photograph of a view of the Bogel's ranch and the surrounding landscape. In the foreground, there is a low fence and a large group of cattle on either side. Inside the fence there are several wooden corrals. In the background, there is brush and what appears to be another large group of cows. On the left of the photograph, there is a long building which may be a barn, another structure, and a windmill. In the background of the photograph, there are long, low mountains A handwritten note at the bottom of the photograph says "Scene on Bogel's Cattle Ranch, Presidio Co. Texas." and "Duncan Photo." There is also a typed sentence attached to the top of the photograph that says, "This is one of the Big Bend's most beautiful landscapes which shows a ranch and cattle grazing."

entry.content: Postcard of a landscape with numerous heads of cattle in the foreground. The caption of the image reads "A Ranch Scene Near Pecos, Texas."

entry.title: [Cattle ranch buildings]
entry.content: Photograph of cattle ranch buildings surrounded by small fenced in areas in Alamosa, Texas at L.S. Ranch headquarters, 1897.

entry.title: [Cattle Outside of a Fence at the LBJ Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of cattle outside of a fence at the LBJ Ranch. Cowboys can be seen amongst them. A ranch building stands in the background.

entry.content: Photograph of a herd of cattle and yearlings standing or lying in a large open range on McFaddin Ranch. Cowboys on horses are in the background.

entry.content: Photograph of Brahman cattle closely-grouped grazing in a grassy pasture with cowhands on horseback in the background.

entry.title: Cattle on the Childers Ranch
entry.content: Photograph of some Hereford cattle in a corral on the Childers Ranch.

entry.title: Handling cattle on Welder's Ranch
entry.content: Photograph of cowboys on horseback working a large herd of cattle, herding them into pens.

entry.title: Ranch Hands Branding Cattle
entry.content: Copy negative of four ranch hands branding a cow. In the center of the photo one man is branding the cow while two other men hold it down. The fourth man and a dog stand watching off to the right side. The men are dressed in boots and cowboy hats. A herd of cattle, horses, and mountains form a backdrop.

entry.title: [Cattle Drive On Ranch, 1918]
entry.content: Photograph of a herd of cattle on a ranch crowded tightly together and facing toward the left, with a fence in the foreground. Two men on horseback are to the right of the cattle, facing the same direction as the herd. Shrubs and small trees are scattered in the background.

entry.title: [Children Watching Cattle]
entry.content: Photograph of Oliver Jacobs' grandchildren kneeling in a pasture and watching cattle. An older boy, left, has turned around and is pointing at the camera.

entry.title: [Spraying Cattle at Matthews Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of ranch hands spraying cattle in a pen at the Matthews Ranch (Lambshead), located north of Albany, Texas. Adjacent to the pen is an additional pen filled with cattle. Behind the pens two ranch hands ride horses in a field where a car stands parked beside a gate. Mesquite trees dot a sloping hill on the horizon.

entry.title: [Young Boy in a Barn with Cattle]
entry.content: Photograph of one of Oliver Jacobs' grandsons standing in a barn near cattle. He is watching a cow nurse a calf. Another calf stands near the wall.

entry.title: [Young Boy in a Barn with Cattle]
entry.content: Photograph of one of Oliver Jacobs' grandsons standing in a barn with cattle. He is smiling at a calf that is nursing off of a cow. An older calf is standing behind the cow.

entry.title: [Young Boy in a Barn with Cattle]
entry.content: Photograph of one of Oliver Jacobs' grandsons standing in a barn near cattle. To his left, a cow is nursing a calf. A larger calf is partially visible behind the cow.

entry.title: [Four Cowboys Unloading Cattle]
entry.content: Photograph of four cowboys unloading three cows from a small trailer inside a covered pen on the Matthews Ranch, located north of Albany, Texas. One cowboy stands on the pen fence, leaning over the side of the trailer, and uses a cattle prod to coax the cows from the trailer.

entry.title: [Cattle on the Sproul Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of a brown cow lying down in front of a plant on the Sproul Ranch in Fort Davis, Texas. There are rocks on the ground in front of the cow.

entry.title: Cattle on the Sproul Ranch
entry.content: Photograph of cattle on the Sproul Ranch. The cattle lays down on the ground near a tree. There is a pile of wood to the right and behind the cattle.

entry.title: [Cattle on the Sproul Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of a black and white cow on the Sproul Ranch in Fort Davis, Texas.

entry.title: Cattle on the Sproul Ranch
entry.content: Photograph of a head of cattle standing in front of trees on the Sproul Ranch. It has a roan coat, and a yellow tag with the number "20" in it in its left ear.

entry.title: [Cattle on the Sproul Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of two cows, one standing and one sitting, in a field on Sproul Ranch in Fort Davis, Texas. Rocks are visible on a slope in the background.

entry.title: Cattle on the Sproul Ranch
entry.content: Photograph of two cattle on the Sproul Ranch. The red and white cow is laying down. The lighter cow is preparing to lay down.

entry.title: [Cattle on the Crump Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of Hereford cattle on the Crump ranch land. Two large cattle and several small calves are seen in the picture.

entry.title: Cattle at the SMS Ranch
entry.content: Photograph of bulls at the SMS Ranch in West Texas.

entry.title: [Ranch House and Cattle]
entry.content: Photograph of a ranch house with trucks parked outside. There is a pen with cattle to the right of the house. A cattle trailer sits next to a power line to the right. A white metal fence runs along the side of a road near the bottom of the photo.

entry.title: [Cattle Being Loaded along a Chute]
entry.content: Photograph of cattle walking along a loading chute. The two animals are maneuvering along the fenced wooden structure towards the direction of the camera. A man in a hat watches by the right side of the chute.

entry.title: [Ranch gate with cowboy, cattle, and horses]
entry.content: Photograph of the ranch gate at the Rocking R--Rahm Ranch. This picture of the gate depicts two cowboys riding horses and herding cattle. A small herding dog is visible next to the cowboys. Underneath their feet, the outline of a rough terrain and foliage can be seen. Behind the gate, the setting sun can be seen.

entry.title: [Cattle by Stream]
entry.content: Photograph of cattle closely-grouped near a stream with trees and a cowhand on horseback in the background.

entry.title: [Steer with "LBJ" Written on Its Side]
entry.content: Photograph of a steer with LBJ painted on it.

entry.title: [Sanzenbacher Ranch Feeding Cattle]
entry.content: Sanzenbacher Ranch Feeding Cattle. In picture, Henry Sanzenbacher and Carl Thompson. Circa 1950: Secret Springs, Texas.

entry.title: Dipping Cattle on the Bogel Ranch
entry.content: This photograph shows a vat for dipping cattle and many people standing around it. The people are all wearing light colored shirts, dark pants, and cowboy hats. According to the related report, the people are Graves, Woodworth, and Sarah Bogel (left to right) with Mexican cowhands. The foreground is focused on the dipping vats which is a canal of concrete with wooden gates and filled half-full with water. In the background, there are some other fences, what appears to be part of a wagon to the far right and mountains in the distance.

entry.title: [Cattle on the Clifton Fielder Ranch]
entry.content: Photograph of feeding cattle on the Clifton Fielder Ranch in Llano County, Texas. The area is enclosed by fencing consisting of wire and wooden posts and there is a car and a shed nearby.

entry.title: Cattle Feeders at SMS Ranch
entry.content: Photograph of cattle feeders at the SMS Ranch in West Texas.

entry.title: [Cattle Pond on Ranch Land]
entry.content: Photograph of a cattle pond on ranch land. John Brittingham, Susan Judd, and R. B. Judd are on horseback on the bank of the pond, with cattle visible among the small trees in the area.

entry.title: Branding Cattle at the Brite Ranch
entry.content: Photographic postcard of cowboys branding cattle on the Brite Ranch in West Texas. It has the name "Bill Bailey" written on the back and it is addressed to Mr. C.E. Brite in Brite, Tex and it is postmarked September 1, 1921 in Marfa, Texas.

entry.title: [Rayzor Ranch Longhorn cattle]
entry.content: Photograph of Rayzor Ranch longhorn cattle grazing at the corner of Scripture St and I-35 Frontage Rd in Denton, Texas. One longhorn (tagged #34) is standing in the center of the photograph, looking at the camera as a calf sticks its head between his back legs. Other cattle can be seen scattered around the field.

entry.title: [Cattle at a Watering Tank]
entry.content: Photograph of a herd of cattle drinking from a shallow tank at the Matthews Ranch (Lambshead). In the distance four cowboys riding horses watch over the herd in front of a grove of mesquite trees.
